title: Ordinary Finite P1 Diagonal Triangles
statement:
Canonical section variables and instances are those of the attached Lean module.

theorem ordinaryFiniteP1_diagonal_triangles (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA) (c : OrdinaryFiniteP1ChernFamily A N hA)
    (hc : OrdinaryFiniteP1ChernFamilySpec A N hA c)
    (b : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (_hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))),
      ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA S)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧ ⊞ ordinaryFiniteUnit A S) ≅
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).obj
          ((ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine S))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧))
    (hb : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))),
      (b S hS).hom = ordinaryFiniteP1KummerMap A N hA t c S hS)
    (hbc : OrdinaryFiniteP1KummerMapBaseChange A N hA t c) :
    (∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))),
      ∃ η : 𝟭 (DerivedCategoryModule A (ProjectiveLine S)) ⟶
          ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) ⋙
            ordinaryFiniteP1Right A N hA S,
        (∀ M : DerivedCategoryModule A (ProjectiveLine S),
          (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).map (η.app M) ≫
            (ordinaryFiniteP1TraceCounit A N hA S (b S hS)).app
              ((ordinaryFinitePushforward A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).obj M) = 𝟙 _) ∧
        (∀ K : DerivedCategoryModule A S,
          η.app ((ordinaryFiniteP1Right A N hA S).obj K) ≫
            (ordinaryFiniteP1Right A N hA S).map
              ((ordinaryFiniteP1TraceCounit A N hA S (b S hS)).app K) = 𝟙 _))

source.place: Supported diagonal kernel, section projection contractions, and counit base change

proof.text: Use the supported diagonal component formula to obtain the two normalized scalar integrals. Normalize the shifted coefficient line along both projections and use the chart trace exchange equations in the existing even-line coordinate trace contractions. Tensor the first scalar section integral by the generic section projection calculation, and use the second scalar integral directly. The generic two-triangle assembly gives a unit for the common-base coefficient. Transport that coefficient along the specified normalized twist pullback; projection naturality identifies its counit with the prescribed Kummer trace counit. Explicitly unfold only the projective-line counit and right-adjoint wrappers when applying the generic coefficient-triangle assembly. Apply the elementary pushed-isomorphism cancellation with the supported map's canonical source object specified explicitly.
Apply the separately proved first and second normalized coordinate exchange identities.
